- Applied improve-code-boundaries to src/ha/worker.rs by proving resolve_replica_upstream had one real caller, then inlining it into observe() and deleting the helper.
- make lint passed; make test passed with 240/240 tests green (nextest also reported 5 leaky tests that were non-fatal and already reflected in Ralph task summaries).
- Committed and pushed the work as c4ed30b after three commits: 969f6e2, 18ec9c5, c4ed30b.
- Ran bash .ralph/task_switch.sh; it updated current_tasks/current_tasks_done, sent the completion email, and again printed `rm: cannot remove .../.ralph/current_task.txt: No such file or directory`.
- Next after any future resume: read progress again, inspect the newly active Ralph task, and continue from the switched state.

- Read prior Codex progress and confirmed the last run already finished a separate boundary cleanup, lint, test, commit, push, and task switch.
- Read the improve-code-boundaries skill and started this run by checking for any pending found_smells task, because the skill requires that before choosing a new boundary issue.
- Next: inspect found_smells, read the relevant smell instructions, then make one targeted src/tests boundary simplification and validate with make lint plus make test.

- Proved the boundary smell in src/dcs/worker.rs with the skill’s compiler-based rename check: renaming only the helper definition made make check fail at exactly one caller, connect_session at src/dcs/worker.rs:242.
- Inlined the one-off connect_client helper into connect_session and deleted the helper, keeping build_connect_options as the remaining real options-construction boundary.
- Next: verify the refactor with make check, then run make lint and make test, inspect git diff, commit including .ralph files, push, and task-switch.

- Removed the now-unused DcsEndpoint import after the inline, and make check is green again.
- Starting the requested full validation run now: make lint first, then make test, explicitly not running make test-long.
- Next: if validation stays green, inspect the final diff, commit including .ralph files, push, append final progress, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.

- Completed one improve-code-boundaries cleanup in src/dcs/worker.rs: proved connect_client had exactly one real caller via the rename-and-make-check workflow, then inlined the connect setup into connect_session and deleted the helper.
- Validation is green: make check passed, make lint passed, and make test passed with nextest reporting 240/240 tests green plus the pre-existing 5 leaky tests already tracked in Ralph.
- Next: commit src/dcs/worker.rs together with the current .ralph task/progress updates, push the branch, append final progress, and run bash .ralph/task_switch.sh.
